scope: Single-model supplementary experiment; one run per condition and pattern. It does not replace the paper's five-model evaluation.

conditions.self_repair: Unguided: the model is told that the CIR needs a concurrency repair, but receives no problem class, location, trace, state, CIR slice, or repair hint.
conditions.coarse: LLM-only issue report: current primary problem class plus a generic class-level description; no SID, witness, state summary, resource/function localization, or CIR slice.
conditions.structured: Complete current Rust feedback: status, bug kind, witness, state summary, resources/functions, CIR slice, constraints, hint.

configuration.secondary_preservation_oracle: Exact preservation of resources, protection entries, function names/kinds, per-function SID sets, goals, and per-function operation multisets. This flags behavior deletion but does not affect stopping.
